name: Neural Scene Graph
definition: A hierarchical scene representation defined as a directed acyclic graph S = (W, C, F, L, E), where C is a camera leaf node, F are representation leaf nodes (static and dynamic), L are latent object code leaf nodes, and E are edges defining the hierarchy.
summary: Neural Scene Graphs represent dynamic scenes as hierarchical graphs separating static backgrounds from dynamic objects, ensuring temporal consistency and avoiding the ghosting artifacts common in NeRFs.
